unreachable.title: Connect to the internet to sign in
unreachable.description: Editools could not reach the account service and your offline access has expired. Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in to Editools
login.description: Free to start. We email you a 6-digit code — no password to remember.
login.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It can take a minute to arrive — check your spam folder too.

account.title: Your account
account.description: Your plan, today's usage and your privacy choices.

status.past_due: Payment late — access continues for a few days

account.offline: You are offline. Editools is working on the limits it saved last time you were connected.
account.privacyDescription: Your files never leave your computer. With this on, Editools also sends anonymous usage counts (which tools you use, whether they worked) so we can improve them. Never file names, links, text or your email.
account.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account and usage history. This cannot be undone.
account.devDescription: Only admins see this. Changes are recorded in the audit log.

consent.title: Help us improve Editools
consent.description: Share anonymous usage data — which tools are used and whether they worked. Never your files, links, text or email. You can change this any time in Account.

pricing.title: Editools Pro
pricing.description: Remove the daily limit and unlock every quality option.
pricing.freeItems: All tools · {{runs}} runs a day · up to {{minutes}} min per file
pricing.proItems: All tools · no daily limit · full quality · long files
pricing.checkoutOpened: The checkout opened in your browser. Come back here when you have paid — Editools unlocks Pro by itself, usually within a minute (Pix and boleto can take longer).
pricing.notYet: No payment found yet for {{email}}. Pix and boleto can take a while — try again in a few minutes.
pricing.sameEmail: Use the same email you signed in with ({{email}}) at checkout.

upgrade.quotaTitle: You used all of today's free runs
upgrade.quotaDescription: Your runs come back {{when}}. Pro has no daily limit.
upgrade.quotaDescriptionNoTime: Your runs come back tomorrow. Pro has no daily limit.
upgrade.limitTitle: This is beyond the free plan

errors.invalid_code: That code did not work. Check it and try again, or ask for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.account_offline: Could not reach the account service. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
